FAQs
01. What is a UGC-recognised online degree course?
It’s an online program approved by the University Grants Commission (UGC), ensuring academic legitimacy and national recognition.
02. Why is UGC recognition important for online degrees?
UGC recognition validates the degree for employment, government exams, and higher education across India.
03.How do I check if an online degree is UGC-approved?
Visit the UGC DEB (Distance Education Bureau) portal for the official list of approved universities and courses.
04.Are UGC-recognised online degrees valid abroad?
They are valid in many countries, but equivalency depends on the destination country’s education recognition policies.
05. Which types of degrees are commonly offered with UGC accreditation?
Popular ones include Online BBA, MBA, B.Com, M.Com, BA in Journalism, and MA in English.
